# Mr Wallet

> Personal budget and expense-tracking app: accounts, transactions, budgets, debts, savings goals,
> recurring transactions, and multi-currency support (including currencies with no minor unit, like
> XOF). No bank connector — data comes in by manual entry or CSV/Excel import. Every amount is
> stored as an integer, never a floating-point number, so balances never drift from rounding. Free
> while the product is in active development. Available in French and English.

Mr Wallet is published by Grey Workers Togo (Zanguera, Lomé, Togo). The marketing site
(mister-wallet.com) is informational only; the application runs at app.mister-wallet.com.
